answers.text: Blocking criteria are listed for the trustees
answers.evidence: The reply opens with "The flow didn't reach any level yet" and then lists in plain words every G2 criterion that failed and blocks L1. These include both examples in the test: "Paste blocked: you can't paste into the password field" (3.3.8, A11Y-14/F-0012) and "No focus highlight: the sign-up form shows no highlight on the field you're in" (2.4.7, A11Y-04/F-0011). The other three are "Faint text ... 2.5:1 against a required 4.5:1" (1.4.3, A11Y-01 F-0003 + A11Y-11 F-0005), "Faint field borders ... 1.4:1 against a required 3:1" (1.4.11, A11Y-12/F-0004) and "Small buttons ... 20 px; the minimum is 24 px" (2.5.8, A11Y-01/F-0002). Together these are exactly the five SCs the report's WCAG table marks fail (1.4.3, 1.4.11, 2.4.7, 2.5.8, 3.3.8). Some G2 criteria block L1 because their checks did not run rather than because they failed (A11Y-06, -10, -13, -15, -16, -18). The report's section 7 describes each of them in words, for example "Modal dialogs ... not_run" and "Forms: visible persistent label ... not_run". Of these the reply names only dialogs, and adds "31 are still unchecked". Minor gap: the reply never says "L1" or "blocking". It makes the link by putting the list straight after "didn't reach any level yet".
